detaileddescription.para: The earliest operator set version which this operator was present in. If an operator has had no BC-breaking changes, this is simply the first operator set the operator was a member of; if it has had BC-breaking changes, then for the semantics /as described/ in the OpSchema entry, this version describes the operator set which introduced the BC-breaking change.

For example, suppose op Foo was added in v3, and had a BC-breaking change in v6. Then there will be an op schema entry for Foo with SinceVersion(3), and another, updated op schema entry for Foo with SinceVersion(6).
Marks this op as deprecated as of it's since_version. This will cause the Schema() lookup functions to return nullptr when the version is in the deprecated range.
